<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Anatomia Palpatória</title>
<meta name="description" content="Curso presencial e 100% prático de Anatomia Palpatória aplicada ao raciocínio clínico, com Denise Almeida. Goiânia — GO, 19 e 20 de setembro de 2026.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
  --deep:#0A1F19;
  --panel:#102B23;
  --panel-2:#0D241D;
  --raised:#17392F;
  --raised-2:#1D4437;
  --olive:#93A45E;
  --olive-bright:#A9BB6C;
  --olive-soft:#B9C79A;
  --orange:#E5662B;
  --orange-bright:#F27A3C;
  --cream:#F4F1E8;
  --text:#D3DCCB;
  --muted:#8FA394;
  --line:rgba(147,164,94,.22);
  --line-soft:rgba(147,164,94,.12);
  --shadow:0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.65);
  --radius:18px;
  --maxw:1180px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  margin:0;
  background:var(--deep);
  color:var(--text);
  font-family:"Barlow",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;text-wrap:balance;color:var(--cream);line-height:1}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
.wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.display{font-family:"Anton",Impact,sans-serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:uppercase}
.eyebrow{
  font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.22em;font-size:.74rem;color:var(--olive-bright);
}
.orange{color:var(--orange)}
.olive{color:var(--olive-bright)}

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.btn{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;justify-content:center;
  font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.02rem;
  padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;border:0;
  letter-spacing:.01em;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease;
  text-align:center;line-height:1.15;
}
.btn-primary{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(229,102,43,.8)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--orange-bright);transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -14px rgba(229,102,43,.9)}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--cream);border:1.5px solid var(--line)}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--olive-bright);color:var(--olive-bright);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn svg{width:1.15em;height:1.15em;flex:none}

/* ---------- top nav ---------- */
.nav{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;
  backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  background:rgba(9,28,22,.82);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-soft);
}
.nav-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:14px 24px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.02em}
.brand .mark{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none}
.brand small{display:block;font-size:.66rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--olive-bright);font-weight:700;line-height:1}
.brand strong{font-size:1rem;color:var(--cream);letter-spacing:.04em}
.nav .btn{padding:11px 20px;font-size:.92rem}
.nav-wa-full{display:inline-flex}
.nav-wa-mini{display:none}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:70px 0 40px}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2}
.hero-badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;
  border:1.5px solid var(--orange);color:var(--cream);font-weight:700;font-size:.78rem;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.hero h1{margin:22px 0 0}
.hero .l1{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8.5vw,6.2rem)}
.hero .l2{font-size:clamp(3.2rem,8.5vw,6.2rem);color:var(--olive-bright)}
.hero .sub{
  font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;
  font-size:clamp(1.05rem,2.6vw,1.5rem);color:var(--cream);margin-top:14px;
  padding-top:16px;border-top:2px solid var(--orange);display:inline-block;
}
.hero-lead{margin-top:22px;max-width:46ch;color:var(--text);font-size:1.06rem}
.facts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:26px}
.fact{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(23,57,47,.6);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--cream);
}
.fact svg{width:19px;height:19px;color:var(--olive-bright);flex:none}
.hero-cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:30px}
.hero-note{margin-top:16px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.hero-photo{position:relative;align-self:end;max-width:365px;justify-self:end;width:100%}
.hero-photo .blob{
  position:absolute;inset:auto -7% -4% -7%;height:92%;
  background:radial-gradient(70% 62% at 55% 42%,var(--olive) 0%,rgba(147,164,94,.45) 45%,transparent 74%);
  filter:blur(3px);z-index:0;border-radius:50% 50% 46% 54%/58% 58% 42% 42%;
}
.hero-photo .portrait{position:relative;z-index:1;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(169,187,108,.4);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);background:#3d5a44}
.hero-photo .portrait::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 55%,rgba(10,31,25,.4))}
.hero-photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:saturate(1.02)}
.tag100{
  position:absolute;left:-8px;bottom:26px;z-index:2;
  background:var(--orange);color:#fff;font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.03em;font-size:1.15rem;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);transform:rotate(-3deg);
}

/* decorative background */
.bg-deco{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.spine{position:absolute;left:-40px;top:-40px;height:120%;opacity:.10}
.wave-line{position:absolute;width:130%;left:-15%;opacity:.5}

/* ---------- section shells ---------- */
section{position:relative}
.band{padding:84px 0}
.band-panel{background:var(--panel)}
.band-deep{background:var(--panel-2)}
.section-head{max-width:60ch}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3.3rem);margin-top:14px}
.section-head p{margin-top:16px;color:var(--text);font-size:1.08rem}

/* wavy divider */
.divider{display:block;width:100%;height:46px}

/* ---------- promise / pillars ---------- */
.promise-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.promise-photo{position:relative;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.promise-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;aspect-ratio:4/5}
.promise-photo::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,transparent 40%,rgba(10,31,25,.65))}
.promise-kicker{
  font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.98;
  font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4.6vw,3rem);color:var(--cream);
}
.promise-kicker em{font-style:normal;color:var(--olive-bright)}
.pillars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
.pillar{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .18s,border-color .18s}
.pillar:hover{transform:translateX(4px);border-color:var(--olive-bright)}
.pillar .ic{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--olive);color:var(--deep)}
.pillar .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.pillar h3{font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--cream);font-size:1.06rem}
.pillar p{margin-top:3px;font-size:.96rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- value cards ---------- */
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.card{
  padding:28px 24px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--raised);
  border:1px solid var(--line);transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s,background .2s;
}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:var(--olive-bright);background:var(--raised-2)}
.card .ic{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(147,164,94,.15);color:var(--olive-bright);margin-bottom:18px}
.card .ic svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.card h3{font-size:1.22rem;color:var(--cream);font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700}
.card p{margin-top:10px;color:var(--text);font-size:.98rem}

/* ---------- about denise ---------- */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.about-photo{position:relative;max-width:370px;width:100%;justify-self:center}
.about-photo .frame{border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;z-index:1}
.about-photo .frame img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/3.7;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 22%}
.about-photo .accent{position:absolute;z-index:0;inset:18px -18px -18px 18px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--olive);opacity:.35}
.creds{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
.cred{padding:18px 22px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.cred b{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--orange);line-height:.85;flex:none}
.cred span{font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.25}
.roles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
.role{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:13px 20px;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(147,164,94,.1);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;color:var(--cream);font-size:.98rem}
.role svg{width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--olive-bright);flex:none}
.about blockquote{margin:22px 0 0;padding-left:20px;border-left:3px solid var(--olive);font-style:italic;color:var(--olive-soft);font-size:1.06rem}

/* ---------- included list ---------- */
.incl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:40px}
.incl-item{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:22px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.incl-item .ic{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.incl-item .ic svg{width:23px;height:23px}
.incl-item h3{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--cream);font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700}
.incl-item p{margin-top:5px;font-size:.94rem;color:var(--muted)}

/* ---------- audience ---------- */
.aud{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
.aud-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:16px 22px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;color:var(--cream);flex:1 1 260px}
.aud-chip .dot{width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--olive-bright);flex:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(147,164,94,.16)}
.aud-note{margin-top:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.96rem;max-width:70ch}

/* ---------- pricing ---------- */
.price-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
.price-card{
  background:linear-gradient(165deg,var(--raised-2),var(--panel-2));
  border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:36px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}
.founder{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--olive);color:var(--deep);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.72rem;padding:7px 15px;border-radius:999px}
.price-main{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;margin:18px 0 4px}
.price-main .cur{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:2rem;color:var(--orange)}
.price-main .val{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;font-size:5.4rem;color:var(--orange);line-height:.85}
.price-lbl{font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--cream);font-size:1.02rem}
.price-split{margin-top:8px;color:var(--olive-soft);font-size:1.02rem}
.price-after{margin-top:20px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:.98rem}
.price-after b{color:var(--cream)}
.pay{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:22px 0 24px}
.pay span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(147,164,94,.12);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--cream)}
.pay svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--olive-bright)}
.scarce{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.scarce h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,5vw,3rem)}
.vac-bar{height:12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(147,164,94,.16);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.vac-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:12%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),var(--orange-bright));border-radius:999px}
.scarce .meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}

/* ---------- schedule ---------- */
.days{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px;margin-top:40px}
.day{background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;position:relative}
.day .dh{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-bottom:16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.day .dh h3{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--cream)}
.day .dh span{font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--olive-bright)}
.slot{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 0}
.slot + .slot{border-top:1px dashed var(--line-soft)}
.slot .t{font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--orange);min-width:118px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.slot .d{color:var(--text);font-size:.98rem}
.slot.brk .t{color:var(--olive-bright)}
.logistics{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
.logistics .fact{background:var(--panel)}

/* ---------- faq ---------- */
.faq{margin-top:36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;max-width:860px}
details{background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:4px 22px;transition:border-color .2s}
details[open]{border-color:var(--olive-bright)}
summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;padding:18px 0;font-weight:700;color:var(--cream);font-size:1.06rem;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px}
summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
summary .chev{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none;color:var(--olive-bright);transition:transform .2s}
details[open] summary .chev{transform:rotate(180deg)}
details p{padding:0 0 20px;color:var(--text);font-size:1rem}

/* ---------- final cta ---------- */
.final{position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;padding:96px 0}
.final::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
   radial-gradient(60% 80% at 50% 0%,rgba(229,102,43,.18),transparent 60%),var(--panel-2)}
.final .inner{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto}
.final h2{font-size:clamp(2.4rem,6.5vw,4.4rem);text-transform:uppercase}
.final p{margin:20px auto 0;max-width:52ch;color:var(--text);font-size:1.1rem}
.final .btn{margin-top:34px;font-size:1.15rem;padding:20px 44px}
.final .phone{margin-top:20px;font-family:"Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--cream);letter-spacing:.04em}
.final .phone span{color:var(--olive-bright)}

/* ---------- footer ---------- */
footer{background:var(--deep);padding:40px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft);color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.foot-inner{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.foot-inner .brand small{color:var(--olive)}

/* floating whatsapp */
.wa-float{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:80;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#25D366;display:none;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 12px 30px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.wa-float svg{width:30px;height:30px;color:#fff}

/* reveal */
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* ---------- syllabus ---------- */
.syl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.mod{background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px;position:relative;transition:transform .2s,border-color .2s}
.mod:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--olive-bright)}
.mod.full{grid-column:1/-1}
.mod-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.mod .num{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--deep);background:var(--olive-bright);width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.mod h3{font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--cream);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em}
.mod ul{list-style:none;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:5px 20px}
.mod.full ul{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr}
.mod ul li{position:relative;padding-left:17px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--text)}
.mod ul li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:.62em;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--orange)}
.mod .apl{margin-top:18px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--olive-soft)}
.mod .apl b{color:var(--cream);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:.74rem;display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.method{margin-top:26px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--raised-2),var(--panel-2));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px;padding:clamp(26px,4vw,40px)}
.method h3{font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.4vw,2.2rem);color:var(--cream)}
.method .lead{margin-top:12px;color:var(--text);max-width:70ch}
.flow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:stretch;margin-top:26px}
.flow .step{flex:1 1 150px;text-align:center;padding:18px 12px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(147,164,94,.1);border:1px solid var(--line);font-family:"Anton",sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--olive-bright);letter-spacing:.02em;font-size:1.05rem;display:grid;place-items:center}
.flow .arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--orange);font-weight:800;flex:none;font-size:1.4rem}
.qs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:26px}
.q{padding:14px 18px;border-left:3px solid var(--olive);background:rgba(0,0,0,.18);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;font-style:italic;color:var(--olive-soft);font-size:.96rem}
.cases{margin-top:24px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;padding:24px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.cases .ic{width:48px;height:48px;flex:none;border-radius:12px;background:var(--orange);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.cases .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
.cases h3{font-family:"Barlow",sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--cream)}
.cases p{margin-top:6px;color:var(--text);font-size:.96rem}
.cases .mini{margin-top:12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.cases .mini span{font-size:.82rem;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(147,164,94,.12);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--olive-soft);font-weight:600}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .syl{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .mod.full ul{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .qs{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .flow .arrow{transform:rotate(90deg)}
  .cases{flex-direction:column}
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:20px}
  .hero-photo{max-width:360px;justify-self:center}
  .promise-grid,.about,.price-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .about-photo{max-width:420px}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .incl,.creds,.days{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .nav-wa-full{display:none}
  .nav-wa-mini{display:inline-flex}
  .wa-float{display:grid}
  .about-photo .accent{inset:14px -10px -14px 14px}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  body{font-size:17px}
  .band{padding:60px 0}
  .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .price-main .val{font-size:4.2rem}
  .facts .fact{font-size:.85rem}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}
</style>
